parsed.rationale: All eight participating records are unnamed extensions (name: "") on CGImage spread across test files (ArtworkServiceTests.swift, ArtworkFetcherTests.swift, NowPlayingServiceTests.swift), a production source file (MultisourceArtworkService.swift), and an app-layer file (NowPlayingInfoCenterManager.swift) across three distinct packages (Artwork, AppServices, app:iOS). The cluster carries no fields_or_signature data and no structural_evidence (jaccard, shared_field_count, shared_ancestor are all null), so there is no demonstrated shared shape or content beyond the coincidence of all being extensions in the same file-name-collision query. Without evidence of duplicated members, no consolidation target can be named or justified.
